# MRI with the subsetted data to make sure the same subjects are used! 
```{r}
current_directory <- getwd()
print(current_directory) 
file_path <- paste(current_directory, '../../data/subject_by_node_Viewing1_Viewing2_subs_schaefer_rois.csv', sep = "/")
data = read.csv(file_path)

motion_summary <- read.csv("../../../MadLibs/code/analysis_fmri/_preparing_data/all_subjects_img_trial_motion_summary.csv")

# Ensure columns are characters for consistent matching
data$Subject <- as.character(data$Subject)

data$img <- as.character(data$stim_file)

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    appraisal_SELF = coalesce(
      appraisal_SELF_cond1,
      appraisal_SELF_cond2
    ) / 100,
    confidence = confidence / 100,
    appraisal_OTHER = appraisal_OTHER_cond1 / 100
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(appraisal_SELF),
    !is.na(appraisal_OTHER),
    !is.na(confidence),
    !is.na(stim_file),
    !is.na(Subject)
  )

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Select node 1
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

node_data_clean <- data %>%
  filter(Node_Number == 1) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(appraisal_SELF),
    !is.na(confidence),
    !is.na(stim_file),
    !is.na(Subject),
    !is.na(cosine_sim_avg_inputs_BERT_context_miniLM_L6)
  )

# Number of included participants
n_distinct(node_data_clean$Subject)

# Experimental trials only
data_experimental <- node_data_clean %>%
  filter(Condition == "expt")


data_experimental$OTHER.SELF <- data_experimental$appraisal_OTHER - data_experimental$appraisal_SELF
data_experimental$semantic_dist <- 1 - data_experimental$cosine_sim_avg_inputs_BERT_context_miniLM_L6

model <- lmer(OTHER.SELF ~ confidence*poly(semantic_dist,3) + (1|img) + (1|Subject), 
                data = data_experimental)
tab_model(model)
```


```{r}
iteration= 'iteration_12_fMRI'
data_experimental$semantic_dist_mc <- data_experimental$semantic_dist - mean(data_experimental$semantic_dist, na.rm = TRUE)


  model <- lmer(OTHER.SELF ~ confidence*poly(semantic_dist,3) + (1|img) + + (1|Subject), 
                  data = data_experimental)
  tab_model(model)
  model <- lmer(OTHER.SELF ~ confidence*semantic_dist + (1|img) + + (1|Subject), 
                  data = data_experimental)
  tab_model(model)  
  
  pred <- ggpredict(model, c("semantic_dist", "confidence [0.25, .5, .75]"))

  p <- ggplot(pred, aes(x = x, y = predicted, 
                         group = group, color = group, 
                         fill = group, linetype = group)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
    geom_line(size = 0.75) +
  #scale_color_manual(values = c("#bbbcbc", "#888989", "black")) +
  #scale_fill_manual(values =  c("#bbbcbc", "#888989", "black")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "black", "black")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values =  c("black", "black", "black")) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("dotted", "longdash", "solid")) +
    labs(y = NULL, x = NULL, title = NULL) +
    theme_classic() +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 1,
    text = element_text(family = "Helvetica Neue"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "none",
            panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(
          colour = "black",
          fill = NA,
          linewidth = 0.5
        ))
p
p <- p +
  force_panelsizes(rows = unit(2.5, "in"), cols = unit(2.5, "in"))

  
  print(p)

  filename <- paste0('../../results/reinterpretation_plots/', iteration, '_confidence_semantic_plot_separated_lmer.png')
  ggsave(filename, p, width = 3, height = 3, dpi = 300)
  
  cat("Saved plot to:", filename, "\n")
```
